value: Takes either a function or an object with `handler` and `duration` (in milliseconds, 500 by default). The handler receives `originalEvent` (the `touchstart`, or the `contextmenu` Android fires for the same hold), `target` (the element the directive is bound to) and `clientX`/`clientY` where the hold started. Moving more than 10px or releasing early cancels the hold.

modifiers.[string]: Custom modifier keys that can be used to configure directive behavior.
